title: Construction Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – North American Fence & Railing, Inc. - Laurel Child Development Center Fencing Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Construction Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and North American Fence & Railing, Inc.,  Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide labor and materials to enclose the fire water backflow equipment with chain-link fencing (7’x 8’x7’), which include double gates and fence posts set in concrete footings, including all work described in the August 7, 2024 proposal attached to this Agreement as Exhibit A, for the Laurel Child Development Center Fencing Project, in the lump sum amount of $7,450.00, which includes a contingency fee of $1,000.00, with the work commencing on September 16, 2024, and being completed by June 30, 2025.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Pays North American Fence & Railing $7,450 for fencing at Laurel Child Development Center
summary: North American Fence & Railing of Oakland will supply labor and materials to enclose the fire water backflow equipment with chain-link fencing, including double gates, at the Laurel Child Development Center. The lump sum of $7,450 includes a $1,000 contingency. Work starts September 16, 2024 and is to finish by June 30, 2025.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Data Media Services, Inc. – Westlake Middle School Security Improvement Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
